gallery.title: File:Preston bus station.jpg
gallery.description:
The bus/coach station/Multi-story carpark in city of Preston,Lancashire.One of the largest in Europe,built in the 60s,and the subject of much heated-debate for the past 4or5 years.Because of a vast urban-regeneration project,developers want to demolish it.Half the population of Preston say it's a 60s classic and should be made a listed-building.The other half say it's a monstrosity and should be got rid of as soon as possible.

What do you think?
